acceptance: Old pins, malformed args, role revocation, and long-running operations produce compatible typed errors.

positive.fixture: older served version runs that version; long run returns a handle all surfaces follow to the same final outcome

negative.fixture: revoked, deprecated, future and mismatched pins; five malformed-argument forms; source session, source role, caller role and caller revoked while a write waits stop it before the source is touched; every error is in the taxonomy

versions.primitive: deprecated exact pin now answers contract_version_unsupported with the served list

security_and_source_permissions: Authority is rechecked immediately before the effect; a cancelled in-flight write ends unknown or provably unapplied, never claimed untouched.
